name: claude-unwire
description: Unwire: reverse engineer the undocumented API of a web UI (router, NAS, smart home, web app) into an OpenAPI spec and a clickable HTML documentation. Read-only by design. Prototype, only for home systems you own.

plugins.name: unwire
plugins.description: Finds published API docs, analyzes the static frontend code of a web UI (HTML, JS bundles, webpack chunks, source maps) and writes an OpenAPI spec plus a clickable HTML documentation. Never calls an endpoint.
